blocks.text: Zscaler provides a default Intrustion Prevention System (IPS) rule that blocks all traffic. You can create granular policies of higher precedence (i.e., higher rule order) than the default rule to explicitly allow specific traffic (e.g., IT Security group traffic matching threats) while blocking all other traffic via the default rule.
You can configure the following recommended IPS Control policy in the Zscaler Admin Console to leverage Zscaler's IPS:

blocks.item: Rule Order: Create this rule with a Rule Order of 1. Since rules are evaluated in ascending numerical order, this rule is evaluated first.
Rule Status: Select Enabled. Enabled rules are actively enforced.

Threat Categories: Select Any to apply this rule to all threat categories, or select specific threat categories based on your organization's needs. Threat categories group common threats (e.g., viruses, botnets, exploits) together.
Action: Select Block/Drop. This silently blocks packets that match the rule.

blocks.text: To learn more about how to configure this rule, see Configuring IPS Control Policy.
